findings.description: `save()` routes an on-screen tap through `dropped()`, which sends a request and shows “Receiving…” even when `expect()` silently refuses to register the transfer. If 20 transfers are already pending, including thumbnails, the reply's chunks are discarded; further taps while the limit remains full send more requests without fetching the photo.
findings.title: Taps can claim a photo is arriving when it isn't
